newsitem.title: USA: National Home Health to acquire two agencies.
newsitem.headline: National Home Health to acquire two agencies.

text.p: National Home Health Care Corp said Wednesday it has an agreement to acquire certain assets of two New York licensed home health care agencies.
The agenices, which have combined annual revenues of about $3.4 million, provide home health care services in the New York metropolitan area, National Home said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed by July.

National Home Chief Financial Officer Robert Heller said that the company would not disclose the names of the agencies being purchased until the deal received preliminary approval from the state Department of Health. That approval is expected to be received in April, he said.
